en:
Man, when can we get outta this 
place? I'm missing so much training...
Yeah...that's true.

But since we're here, aren't 
you glad you met me?
Glad I met you?

<CLT=cltMIND>Well...I guess Kaito has saved
me before...

It's nothing to be embarrassed about! 
Just be proud that you're my sidekick!
<CLT=cltMIND>...A sidekick.

I've got quite the record. I could even 
be called the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hero<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Your "record"? What do you mean?

Heh, to tell the truth...I've had a 
number of sidekicks in the past.

I'm only an astronaut trainee, but in 
other fields, my name is legend!
Ah, really...?
Yup! For example...

That star rookie in the major league? 
He used to be my sidekick!
What!?

That engineer who won a Nobel Prize? 
He also used to be my sidekick.

I even showed our current prime 
minister the ropes of politics.

Oh yeah! And that pop sensation?
I taught her to sing and dance!
Ah, I-I see...

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know about this...
Some of those people are older than Kaito.

That said...I only nudged them 
in the right direction.

Don't doubt yourself! You just 
gotta follow the path you believe in!

If you're lost, I'll believe in you!
If you get scared, I'll help you!
Yeah...

With just a nudge, a person can change. 
They can break outta their shell.

And it's a real man that gives them 
the encouragement they need!
<CLT=cltMIND>That's true.

<CLT=cltMIND>Even if it's just one person...
anyone would be encouraged by that.

<CLT=cltMIND>But that one person has to be special.
It has to be someone like Kaito...

If you wanna talk about something, 
don't hesitate! We'll talk it out!

Your worry is my worry!
My worry is your worry!
And there's nothing wrong with that!
Ah, yeah...thank you.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito is always so honest and approachable.
He's willing to help you with anything.

<CLT=cltMIND>...Only someone like
Kaito could help me.

<CLT=cltMIND>Only someone like him could
tell me what I need to hear.

<CLT=cltMIND>...Ah, n-never mind. I shouldn't
be talking about another boy like that...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kaito's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and I went our separate ways,
and I returned to my room.
